title: Spade, the SPASTAZ map editor
description:
The 3D level editor every SPASTAZ map is built in. Drag parts, walls, rooms, stairs, furniture and gameplay markers from the toolbox into the 3D view; doors and windows dropped on a wall cut their own hole.
It also does terrain, water and painted foliage, weather and time of day, and a map checker that catches problems before you play. Press F5 and Spade launches the game with your map loaded.
howItWorks:
Written in C with raylib, sharing the map code with the game so what you build is exactly what loads.
Co-op editing lets you host a map and edit it with other people, directly or through online rooms on spastaz.com.
Lua plugins and a built-in Lua console automate repetitive work, and trigger parts can call mod scripts in game.
Terrain, water, foliage and models ride on the end of the map file as a versioned, checksummed trailer, so older builds still read the maps.
